messages:
maria: Heads-up from legal: some customers require proof of access (who downloaded an audit export and when). What do we currently record?
kevin: We log export_created and presign_generated. We don't see object-store GETs for presigned URLs.
alex: Two paths: 1) proxy downloads through us and log each GET, or 2) produce a signed proof at generation (JWT) that proves who generated the export. JWT doesn't prove later access.
nora: Proxying is heavier (egress, infra). Can be opt-in per-tenant. Suggest proxy_by_default for Dedicated/Private. Hosted can use JWT or sampled proxy.
maria: UX/console: need a downloads table showing time, attributed_user, method (proxy/presign), and proof link. Banner when tenant is opted into proxy.
kevin: Proposed API flag: attribution_mode: generate_only|proxy_all|proxy_when_enrolled. Telemetry events: export_initiated, presign_generated, download_attempt, download_confirmed (proxy).
alex: Security: do NOT accept actor_id from client in presign call. Attribution must come from authenticated session.
nora: Billing: should proxy egress count toward tenant bandwidth? Hosted probably yes; Dedicated negotiable. Update billing UI.
maria: Retention: legal needs up to 7 years. Plan: stream download events to customer-owned S3 or tiered long-retention store.
kevin: Action items: I'll draft RFC with API shapes + telemetry.
alex: I'll prototype proxy streaming and signed-proof JWT format.
nora: I'll mock console table + enrollment banner.
export-bot: Created ticket INFR-3123: "export: attribution_mode + proxy + proofs" (<https://tracker.local/INFR-3123>) :white_check_mark:
maria: Sync tomorrow 10am to review RFC and mocks.
